subject.title: feat(webchat): lobster pet visits — comes and goes, roams perches, shooable, with a setting

question: Should the core web UI change the sidebar pet from an always-present status mascot to rare scheduled visits with a persistent Appearance opt-out?
rationale: This is a product tone and user-settings decision, not a broken-behavior repair, and the PR carries the protected maintainer label while adding a new visible preference.

options.title: Approve visits plus opt-out
options.body: Rebase the PR, keep the browser-local opt-out, and merge after conflict resolution and final UI proof review.

options.title: Keep the permanent pet
options.body: Ask the author to close or revise the PR so the existing always-present sidebar pet remains the product behavior.

options.title: Keep visits without a setting
options.body: Accept the occasional-visit model but remove the persistent Appearance preference to avoid another settings surface.

recommendation.title: Approve visits plus opt-out
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, keep the browser-local opt-out, and merge after conflict resolution and final UI proof review.
